$comment: D-MIR-DYLIB-SELF-CALL-BYPASSES-WEAK-COALESCING, the ADDRESS half, CONTROL direction. The row is about a SHARED LIBRARY that must not materialize its OWN body's address for a name its loader may replace: `&w` inside the library and `&w` in the executable would then be two different pointers for one identifier, where C 6.2.2p2 gives one identifier one function/object across the whole program -- a callback table, a registration or a function-pointer comparison that crosses the image boundary answers wrong, silently. MEASURED 2026-09-05 (gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3, one .so each, -O1, with the `static` and visibility("hidden") siblings in the SAME object as the in-object control and the identical source built as a -pie and a -no-pie executable as the out-of-object control): both references materialize the address of a weak OR strong-global, default-visibility definition inside a .so by LOADING a R_X86_64_GLOB_DAT GOT slot, for a FUNCTION and for a DATA object alike, and leave the static/hidden siblings a bare lea. An EXECUTABLE declares nothing preemptible because the main executable is always its own winner under both loaders -- in the same probe all eight subjects are a bare lea there, -pie and -no-pie alike. A corpus example cannot build a shared library and a rival consumer together, so the divergence itself is witnessed by execution outside this harness (the DSS-built .so's &w, &st, &wd and &sd all compare EQUAL to the consumer executable's, against a gcc-built control answering identically in the same run, on elf64-x86_64 and elf64-aarch64 under qemu, debug and --config=release). THIS example pins the half the harness CAN carry, and it is the half that guards the cost: an executable whose address-takes were routed would pay a load through memory to reach a definition nothing can replace, and on an ELF or Mach-O exec -- which cannot carry a reference resolved from the loader's global scope -- would be REFUSED outright. SHAPE: all four cells of the decision appear TWICE, once as a FUNCTION and once as a DATA object, because the decision is about a DEFINITION the loader can see rather than about functions; every address is taken through a helper selected by a RUNTIME value (argc - 1) so no pass sees a constant index, and each runtime address is compared against the same definition named in a static table, so the IDENTITY the row protects is asserted by the program itself. What this example asserts is the exit code on both arms. The pe arm RUNS on windows, elf x86_64 on linux, elf arm64 under qemu, macho arm64 on darwin.
